entries.en: I met up with Chihaya[n]at the aquarium...

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: Wow...

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: My hometown definitely had fish,[n]but they were nowhere near as[n]elegant as these...

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: You know, Feng Shui says that water[n]represents financial prosperity.

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: So, maybe being here will bring us[n]great wealth and fortune!

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: ...Well, maybe not.

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: But I'm getting to spend all this time[n]with you, at such a beautiful place...

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: I must be luckier than I realized!

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: Um, by the way... Did you invite me[n]out because it's White Day today?
Of course.
That's correct.

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: Thank you so much!

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: I-I saw it coming, of course! Our fates[n]clearly showed me that you would[n]return my affections.

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: Um, by the way... Did you invite me[n]out because it's White Day today?
Of course.
That's correct.

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: I-I knew it!

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: After we didn't get to see each other[n]on Valentine's Day, I got worried...

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: I suppose it was fate after all!

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: Um, by the way... Did you invite me[n]out today because it's White Day?
Of course.
Yes.

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: ...Good. It's a sensible first step towards[n]getting your good karma back.
...Chihaya seems pleased.

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: Thank you for taking me out today.[n]I had a lot of fun.
I made some reservations.
We still have dinner.

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: Oh! Really?

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: Well... then I'll leave it to you.
